name: dev-workbench
description: Skills, agents and commands packaged as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Eight shared engineering skills — backend and frontend architecture, security review, PostgreSQL table design, TypeScript type work, Mermaid diagrams, the four-level severity scale and the rule for discovering a repository's own commands. The single source other plugins depend on instead of copying.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Two read-only agents for questions that need a checkable answer — a researcher that reports how something works or what the outside world says, with every claim addressed to a path:line or a URL it opened, and a cheap investigator that traces what connects to what.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: An agent that reviews boundaries and nothing else — ring placement, dependency direction, ports and adapters, and the Server/Client line. Reads the repository's own architecture rules first and works where the automated gate cannot reach.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development as four agents and three skills — spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier, orchestrated by run-plan, with a retrospective and an insights recorder.
